description: In the DLP bootcamp documents, a reference labeled as the AI Adoption Maturity Assessment pointed to ../AI-Deep-Learning-Program/Resources/Measures-and-Assessments/AI-Adoption-Maturity-Assessment.md. David corrected: that file is not the maturity assessment at all. The link was attached based on the filename without verifying the file's actual content.
correction: The referenced file's content is something other than the AI Adoption Maturity Assessment. The actual assessment lives elsewhere (investigation in progress at time of logging). A link whose label asserts what a document IS must be verified against the document's content, not inferred from its filename.
systemic_fix: Proposed: when a deliverable references an existing source document by name, the creating agent must open the target file and confirm its content matches the label before shipping the reference.
